question: Ishaan and Meghna have to travel from Delhi to Kanpur in their respective cars. Ishaan is driving at 90 km/hr while Meghna is driving at 65 km/hr. Find the time taken by Meghna to reach Kanpur if Ishaan takes 13 hours.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When distance is constant, Speed and Time are inversely proportional.

Speed Ratio (Ishaan : Meghna) = 90 : 65 = 18 : 13

Time Ratio (Ishaan : Meghna) = 13 : 18

Since Ishaan takes 13 parts, which corresponds to exactly 13 hours,

Meghna will take 18 parts = 18 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 Delhi
 Kanpur
 
 
• 
 
 
• 
 

 Ishaan: 90 km/hr | 13 hrs

 
• 
 

 Meghna: 65 km/hr | ? hrs
 
 Distance = Speed × Time (Constant)

**Given:**

Ishaan's speed = 90 km/hr, Time taken by Ishaan = 13 hours

Meghna's speed = 65 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = Ishaan's Speed × Ishaan's Time

⇒ Total Distance = 90 × 13 = 1170 km

⇒ Time taken by Meghna = Total Distance ÷ Meghna's Speed

⇒ Time taken by Meghna = 1170 ÷ 65

⇒ Time taken by Meghna = 18 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 18 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportion of Speed and Time

When the distance covered is constant, the speed of an object is inversely proportional to the time taken (S ∝ 1/T). Hence, S₁/S₂ = T₂/T₁.

Relative Speed

When two bodies move in the same direction, their relative speed is |S₁ − S₂|. When moving in opposite directions, relative speed is S₁ + S₂.

Average Speed

Average Speed is calculated as Total Distance ÷ Total Time. If two equal distances are covered at speeds a and b, Average Speed = (2ab) ÷ (a + b).
